name: Gainfully Employed
source:
What lies in store for us after we shuffle off this mortal coil? Why wonder, when you can take matters into your own hands? By embracing the potential of modern technology, we can forge an afterlife of our own design. 

But nothing in this life or the next comes for free. To maintain your eternity, you'll need to be gainfully employed.

[From [url=https://gnollwayhome.itch.io/gainfully-employed]Itch.io[/url]]
